# Cloud Agents settings

Workspace admins can configure Cloud Agents from the Cloud Agents dashboard.

## Environment management

The Environments view lists the saved environments available to your team.

Open an environment to review whether it uses a snapshot or `.cursor/environment.json`. The Builds tab shows the prepared environment versions.

## Default settings

Default model, default repository, and base branch.

## Network access settings

User and team settings support Default + allowlist and Allowlist only.

## Security settings

Display agent summary controls whether Cursor shows file-diff images.

## Team feature settings

Team admins can turn features on or off for their team.

### Team follow-ups

Team members can send follow-up messages to cloud agents created by other users on the same team.

### Lateral movement and secret exposure

A follow-up can instruct the agent to read environment variables or push credentials to an external endpoint. Treat this setting with the same care you would give shared SSH keys.
